name: Malta
headline: *MALTA* IS SMALLER THAN YOU THINK
intro: You can drive across the whole country in 45 minutes, which is exactly why people rush it and see a third of it.

mustSee.name: Valletta
mustSee.note: The whole city is the sight. Start at the Upper Barrakka Gardens for the harbour.

mustSee.name: The Grand Harbour
mustSee.note: Take the Sliema ferry both ways. Two euros, best view in the country.

mustSee.name: Mdina
mustSee.note: Silent city, and after the day trips leave at six it actually is.

mustSee.name: Comino's Blue Lagoon
mustSee.note: Photogenic and completely overrun by ten in the morning. First boat or don't.

seasons.spring: April and May. Everything is green for the only time all year, sea is swimmable by mid-May, and the heat hasn't arrived.
seasons.summer: June to September is hard sun and no shade. Locals swim at seven in the morning and again at seven at night. Copy them.
seasons.autumn: October is the best month here. Sea is at its warmest after a summer of heating, and the crowds have thinned.
seasons.winter: Mild, windy, and wet in short bursts. Good for walking the cliffs. Half the beach places close.

transport: No trains. Buses go everywhere and cost almost nothing, but they're slow and they fill up — an hour to cross the island is normal. The Gozo ferry from Ċirkewwa runs every 45 minutes and takes cars. Driving is on the left, which catches people out, and Maltese roundabouts are their own event.
